Title: Public Preview: Optimize agents from insights in Foundry Agent Service

Body.Content:
Optimization from insights is in public preview in Foundry Agent Service. In the Foundry portal, start from an eligible insight in a prompt-agent trace to generate and evaluate candidate changes to the agent's instructions and function-calling tool descriptions. This portal workflow supports only prompt agents that do not use the Microsoft Copilot harness; hosted agents use a separate optimization workflow.

For hosted-agent optimization, use the Microsoft Foundry Toolkit extension for Visual Studio Code or the Azure Developer CLI with the microsoft.foundry extension. Review candidate changes and evaluation results before promoting a new agent version. If an agent's tools can change production systems, use read-only access or isolated test resources during optimization. 

Learn more:

  • Hosted-agent optimization quickstart
  • Fix insights with agent optimizer (preview)
